focus: Candidate (a): advisor-brief pointer — emit, silence, cost, matching, portability

statement: Brief emission: three emit sites in render.ts (:441 ambiguous, :449 normal, :486 fallback); route portion capped at 80 tokens; directives appended after the cap so never truncated.
Measured byte sizes: route line 42B, DIRECTIVES_LABEL 12B, HYGIENE_DIRECTIVE 207B, full brief ~261B (~65 tokens); a compact pointer draft is 162B (~40 tokens).

Dedup: full delivery on first message/boundaries/content change/transcript shrink; suppressed to route-only head on proven repeats; fail-safe full on any missing evidence; kill switch restores always-full.

The renderer has no repo-relevance signal (typed advisor output only); the handler carries workspaceRoot, so gating on REPO RULES.md existence is feasible but splits directive composition across surfaces; unconditional emission fires in repos where Gate 5 has nothing to load.
Candidate (a) is a prompt-time reminder surface, not action-keyed; its claimed value is timing (arrives before the model plans the turn) and AGENTS.md-absent runtimes.
Blast radius of adding a directive: render.ts three emit sites, OpenCode plugin mirror, and exact-string tests pinning brief bytes.
Portability constraint: pointer must name the repo-root router (REPO RULES.md), never the corpus path; corpus location differs across the three federation layers.

022's bar applied to candidate (a): the pointer restates a Gate-5 disposition carried by the always-loaded doc and names no gate-enforced prohibition; the hygiene directive survives on exactly the two prongs the pointer lacks (specific prohibition + tooling gate).
